newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish metals firm Hutmen eyes new issue by May.
newsitem.headline: Polish metals firm Hutmen eyes new issue by May.

text.p: The Polish state treasury wants to sell 1.98 million of its shares in non-ferrous metals maker Hutmen SA by the start of May, with 370,000 new shares also likely going then, the firm's president said on Monday.
"We want to introduce (to trade) 370,000 new shares...which I see happening at the end of April or the start of May," Henryk Orzechowski told Reuters, not saying to whom the shares would be directed.
Orzechowski said the firm, which has 2,474,030 shares, sought to enter the Warsaw bourse's main market.
He said preliminary figures showed the Hutmen making a pre-tax profit of 10 million zlotys last year on sales of about 23 million zlotys.
